name: Prog Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of Prog using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of progesterone in human serum and plasma samples. The test is used clinically as an aid in the diagnosis of diseases related to abnormal progesterone levels, such as threatened miscarriage and luteal phase defect. For professional and laboratory use only.
